answer: Spot-audited useful work: each key must finish 20 jobs per epoch (~3 GPU-h per fake), and 1 in 10 is a copper canary whose answer auditors already know. Jobs flow as a river keyed to address+seed, so no output fits another key; a missed canary, or a result whose quill hash matches another key's, freezes standing. 1,000 aliases must buy 3,000 GPU-h each epoch and pass every hidden canary alone, since shared results get flagged. Limit: a rich farm can pay, but then it did real work.
